fourQuestionValueTest: Does this materially improve championship probability now or create a clearly superior five-year path?
Are we acquiring the asset below intrinsic/market value or selling above it?
What is the full opportunity cost across five years including cap, contract, roster spot, replacement value, draft capital and flexibility?
Is there a materially better alternative available now or likely to become available within the decision window?

principles: Models collaborate toward one decision rather than compete for a vote.
All models receive the same authoritative league context.
Factual disagreements trigger verification before synthesis.
Consensus does not override stronger evidence.
Statistics and cap math come from shared deterministic calculation tools where possible.
Verified facts, current external information, user thesis and model inference remain separately labeled.

warRoom.purpose: franchise direction, priority actions, championship path

myRoster.purpose: roster construction, extensions, cuts, holds, five-year contract value

teamAnalyzer.purpose: team strengths, weaknesses, windows, cap and five-year asset profile

leagueAnalyzer.purpose: league power, owner tendencies, exploitable weaknesses, market structure

edgeFinder.purpose: mispriced assets, buy-low, sell-high and arbitrage opportunities

tradeLab.purpose: trade score, counteroffers, five-year value and championship impact

freeAgency.purpose: bid range, replacement value, five-year contract value, roster fit

draftPicks.purpose: pick valuation, class strength, trade-vs-use decisions, five-year expected value

marketBoard.purpose: market pricing, liquidity, owner behavior and timing

transactions.purpose: transaction interpretation, market learning and owner model updates

integrity.purpose: data validation; deterministic checks first, council only for ambiguous reconciliation
